usedFor: Easybroker holds properties and contact requests, and Conversion Chats messages the requester when “New Contact Request” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Request” in Easybroker, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new inquiry gets a templated reply sent through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “New Contact Request” is polling, so the message goes out after a scheduled check.
